notes.title: Patch Release Notification (Ver.1.0.7)

[b]Announcement[/b]
We have released patch Ver.1.0.7,  which fixes the following issues.


[b]Fix Details[/b]

- Fixed a bug where charms that were once obtained and then lost could not be purchased when they appeared in the shop again.
- Made additional fixes for a bug that prevented the acquisition of certain achievements.
   * Adjustments have been made so that those who have already met the conditions for achievement can now obtain them.
- Fixed some text errors.


[b]Additional Information[/b]
We will continue to address other reported bugs and issues as we move forward.


Thank you.

notes.title: Patch Release Notification (Ver. 1.0.4)
notes.notes:
[b]Announcement[/b]
・We have released Patch Ver1.0.4 to address the following issue.


[b]Fix Details[/b]
・We have made adjustments so that the synchronization of save data with Steam Cloud now operates correctly.
    ・The details are described below.
・We have made corrections to areas believed to be causing issues with the game not starting properly.
    


[h3]Regarding Steam Cloud Saves[/h3]
There has been an issue where save data was not properly syncing with Steam Cloud, which has been addressed in the update to Ver.1.0.4.

After this update, save data synchronization with Steam Cloud will function properly. For those playing "Yohane the Parhelion - NUMAZU in the MIRAGE -" on multiple PCs, the following message may appear when starting the game:
"Gameplay Data has been found on this PC. Would you like to continue the game with this data?"

If this message appears, please check each data and select the data you wish to play with.

・For those who wish to play with data saved on their PC : Please select "Continuing the game with the data on this PC."
・For those who wish to play with data from Steam Cloud : Please select "Continuing the game with data from Steam Cloud."


This message will not appear for those who play "Yohane the Parhelion - NUMAZU in the MIRAGE -" on only one PC.


[b]Additional Information[/b]
・We will continue to address other reported bugs and issues as we move forward.
    
    
   
Thank you.
